part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) will continue to implement case-by-case reviews for certain high-performance chips exported to PRC companies, with an increase in the approval rate of previously restricted transactions to at least 5% by 2027-08-09.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security
resolution_criteria.metric: Percentage of high-performance chip export license applications to PRC companies approved under case-by-case review that were previously under a presumption of denial

baseline.value: N/A (policy shift implemented Jan 13, 2026; specific approval rate not published)

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: cumulative percentage of approved licenses under case-by-case review that were previously denied, measured from 2026-01-13

part1_forecasts.statement: A statutory ban on advanced chip sales to China, similar to the AI OVERWATCH Act, will be enacted, impacting at least 3 U.S. chip manufacturers' export capabilities to the PRC by 2028-02-08.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of U.S. chip manufacturers subject to a statutory ban on advanced chip sales to the PRC

baseline.value: 0 (AI OVERWATCH Act advanced Jan 21, 2026, but not enacted)

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count of unique U.S. chip manufacturers subject to an enacted statutory ban

part1_forecasts.statement: The United States will maintain its dominant position in global AI compute capacity, controlling at least 70% of the market share by 2031-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Percentage of global AI compute capacity controlled by the United States

part1_forecasts.statement: The 'GOLD EAGLE' initiative will lead to the identification and remediation of at least 100 software vulnerabilities impacting U.S. national security systems by 2027-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of software vulnerabilities identified and remediated
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: cumulative count of unique software vulnerabilities reported as remediated by the GOLD EAGLE initiative

part1_forecasts.statement: The MATCH Act will result in a 10% year-over-year reduction in the value of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment imported into China by 2028-02-08.

resolution_criteria.metric: Year-over-year percentage decrease in the value of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment imported into China

baseline.value: N/A (MATCH Act introduced April 2, 2026; impact data not yet available)

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: annual percentage change in import value of specified equipment

part1_forecasts.statement: The Genesis Mission, expanded through federal commitments, will facilitate at least 5 scientific discoveries demonstrably accelerated by AI by 2029-08-09.

resolution_criteria.source: Office of Science and Technology Policy
resolution_criteria.metric: Number of scientific discoveries demonstrably accelerated by AI
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: cumulative count of peer-reviewed scientific discoveries explicitly citing Genesis Mission AI acceleration

part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. government will impose further export controls beyond advanced chips, specifically targeting AI-related software, impacting at least 2 new categories of export by 2028-02-08.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of new categories of AI-related software subject to export controls
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count of distinct software categories added to export control lists

part1_forecasts.statement: China's share of global advanced chip production will fall by at least 3 percentage points by 2030-08-09 due to U.S. regulations and equipment controls.

resolution_criteria.metric: Percentage point change in China's share of global advanced chip production

baseline.value: N/A (specific China production share data not provided in dossier)

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: percentage point change in market share

part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. federal government will increase direct investment or grant funding for domestic AI semiconductor manufacturing by at least $10 billion by 2027-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Cumulative increase in federal investment or grant funding for domestic AI semiconductor manufacturing

baseline.value: N/A (specific total federal investment for AI semiconductors not published)

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: dollar amount of new, dedicated federal funding announcements or disbursements

part1_forecasts.statement: International collaboration on AI security standards will result in at least 5 allied nations signing onto U.S.-proposed frameworks by 2029-08-09.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of allied nations signing onto U.S.-proposed AI national security frameworks
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count of unique allied nations with an officially signed agreement or endorsement
